an5.67:1.1: “Bhikkhus, any monk or nun who develops and cultivates five qualities can expect one of two results:
an5.67:1.2: enlightenment in this very life, or if there’s residue left behind, non-return.
an5.67:2.2: A bhikkhu develops the basis of psychic power that has concentration due to enthusiasm, and active effort …
an5.67:2.3: A bhikkhu develops the basis of psychic power that has concentration due to energy, and active effort …
an5.67:2.4: A bhikkhu develops the basis of psychic power that has concentration due to mental development, and active effort …
an5.67:2.5: A bhikkhu develops the basis of psychic power that has concentration due to inquiry, and active effort.
an5.67:2.6: And the fifth is sheer vigor.
an5.67:2.7: Any monk or nun who develops and cultivates these five qualities can expect one of two results:
an5.67:2.8: enlightenment in this very life, or if there’s residue left behind, non-return.”
